arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ ابْتَلَيْتَنَا فِي أَرْزَاقِنَا بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ وَفِي آجَالِنَا بِطُولِ الأمَلِ حَتَّى الْتَمَسْنَا أَرْزَاقَكَ مِنْ عِنْدِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ، وَطَمِعْنَا بِآمَالِنَا فِي أَعْمَارِ الْمُعَمَّرِينَ.
transliteration: allāhumma innaka ibtalaītana fī arzāqinā bisū'i aẓ-ẓanni wa fī ajālinā biṭūli al-amal ḥattá al-tamasnā ʾarzāqaka min ʿindi al-marzūqīn wa ṭamʿinā bi-āmālinā fī aʿmār al-muʿammarīn
english_text: O God, Thou hast tried us with distrust in our provisions and the expectation of long lives, until we begged for provisions from those who are provided and craved in our expectations the life-spans of the long-lived!

arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَهَبْ لَنَا يَقِيناً صَادِقاً تَكْفِينا بِهِ مِنْ مَؤونَةِ الطَّلَبِ، وَأَلْهِمْنَا ثِقَةً خَالِصَةً تُعْفِينَا بِهَا مِنْ شِدَّةِ النَّصَبِ،
transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa hab lana yaqeenan saadiqan takfeena bihi min ma'oonati at-talab wa alhimna thiqatan khalisatan tuʿfeena biha min shiddati al-nasab
english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, give us a true certainty that will suffice us the burden of seeking, and inspire us with a sincere trust that will release us from the hardship of exertion!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ مَا صَرَّحتَ بِهِ مِنْ عِدَتِكَ فِي وَحْيِكَ، وَأَتْبَعْتَهُ مِنْ قَسَمِكَ فِي كِتَابِكَ قَاطِعاً لاهْتِمَامِنَا بِالرِّزْقِ الَّـذِيْ تَكَفَّلْتَ بِهِ وَحَسْمَاً لِلاشْتِغَالِ بِمَا ضَمِنْتَ الْكِفَايَةَ لَهُ،
transliteration: wajʿal mā ṣarraḥta bihī min ʿidaditika fī wahyika wa ʾatbaʿtahu min qasamika fī kitabika qaṭiʿan lahtimāmīnā bir-rizqi alladhī takaffalt bihi wa ḥasmān li-lash-tiġāli bi-mā ḍamin-tal-kifāya lahu
english_text: Let Thy clear promise in Thy Revelation which Thou hast followed in Thy Book with Thy oath cut off our worry about the provision for which Thou hast made Thyself responsible and sever our occupation with everything whose sufficiency Thou hast guaranteed!

arabic_text: فَقُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ الْحَقُّ الاصْـدَقُ وَأَقْسَمْتَ وَقَسَمُكَ الأَبَرُّ الأَوْفى: ( وَفِي السَّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ )
transliteration: faqultu waqawluka al-haqqul-asdaq wa'aqsamta waqasamuka al-abarru al-awfa wa fī al-samāʾi rizqukum wa mā tuʿadoon
english_text: For Thou hast said - and Thy word is the most truthful truth and Thou hast sworn - and Thy oath is the most kept and fulfilled "In the heaven are your provision and everything you are promised" (51:22)!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ قُلْتَ: ( فَوَرَبِّ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ إنَّهُ لَحَقٌّ مِثْلَ مَا أَنَّكُمْ تَنْطِقُوْنَ ).
transliteration: thumma qult: (fawarabbi alssama'i wal-ardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiquun)
english_text: And then Thou hast said, "So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech" (51:23)!
